caption: R6 500 rent, R2 800 just to move in. Was your first month out as bad?

slides.title:
What moving out cost
me in month one
on R17 400 p/m
Living in Bellville
slides.body:
Female, 25
Single, just moved out of her parents' house
Job: Junior reporter, community newspaper
Net salary: R17 400 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.body: I was paying my mother R1 500 board. This is the number she warned me about.

slides.title: Move-in costs
slides.includes: Second half of the deposit, bakkie hire, a mattress
slides.body: A second-hand mattress is R900. A new one is R3 400. I chose the one I will regret less.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: First proper shop, cooking things I did not know I needed
slides.body: Salt, oil, a pot. Nobody tells you the first shop is half equipment.

slides.title: Transport
slides.includes: MyCiTi bus, Uber when it is dark
slides.body: I take the bus in daylight and Uber at night. That second half is where it goes.

slides.title: Eating out
slides.body: I eat at my mother's twice a week and I still spent R1 600. I do not know how.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: black tax, prepaid electricity, funeral policy, office stokvel, phone
slides.body: R2 000 of things I used to never see. My mom paid for electricity without telling me.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R17 400. Month two should be easier because there is no mattress. I keep telling myself that.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded my first month's statement to Beyond Horizon so I could see what moving out really cost.

The move-in costs were their own category.

No bank login needed.
